study: studies/identifiability/junyi-taxonomy-control (taxonomy_control.py) -- learner side run on DataShop ds1275 (handover 2026-10-09 task 1a)
note: Pre-registered (2f701b1); script, seed, thresholds and verdict strings unchanged. ds1275 'All Data' export MD5 edbbcaf83211085be980ab02ff186127 matches data/data-sources.json. REPRODUCTION PASSED: 47 rated pairs with >=15 learners per order, positional rho +0.29914 (committed +0.29914). VERDICT: EXPLAINED BY TAXONOMY DISTANCE (UNDERPOWERED: floor F2 failed). rho_T +0.297 (tie-averaged; distance 0/1/2 = 18/26/3 pairs); partial rho given distance +0.127 (< 0.5 rho_T = 0.149; given map distance +0.195); C1 within-distance derangement mean +0.179 (SD 0.100, 2,000 derangements), one-sided p 0.12; C2 matched control (pool 1,394 unrated pairs, 47/47 strict matches, 1.00x pairs, 1.36x median coverage) mean rho_C2 +0.231 (SD 0.127 over 2,000 assignments) >= 0.5 rho_T; Delta +0.066 [-0.308, +0.434] (2,000 bootstraps over treatment pairs, control redrawn each). Signs: Spearman(rating, dist) -0.635 and Spearman(gap, dist) -0.322 in the treatment (pool -0.089), both negative, the configuration in which distance can produce a positive rho_T. FLOOR beside it (2026-10-07, not re-run): F1 PASS, F3 PASS, F2 FAIL, only 31.4% power to reach SURVIVES at the observed ~0.30 (80% MDE 0.50); per the pre-registration the verdict is therefore not a finding about the raters. Post-hoc: a planted specific effect of 0.30 was called EXPLAINED in 0% of floor datasets (distance-only confound 87%); the floor's distance mix (54/21/25%) differs from the treatment's (38/55/6%). HELD sections identical to the 2026-10-07 run (rating vs dist -0.740 [-0.759, -0.720]; AUX d 0.955 -> 0.442, ATTENUATED). F4 stays 'points the right way, not established': most of the +0.299 is reproduced by taxonomy distance alone. Moves nothing.
